messages:
maya.chen: Quick intake — tempest-lite-7b-qat is ready for perf + quality bring-up. Goals: 8k ctx support, P95 latency target ~60ms, throughput >=120 tok/s on A40. Need: baseline fp16, int8-ptq, int8-qat runs; batching profile sweep; ctx-length sweep; and full regression on prod-smoke-v2 and dialog-robustness. Who can own the bench? ping @arjun.patel

arjun.patel: I can take this. Plan: fp16 baseline -> int8-ptq -> int8-qat. Will run ctx sweep [512,2048,4096,8192] + batch sizes [1,8,32,64]. Need HF model link and any required special kernels.

samir.k: Add quality checks: logprob deltas + sacrebleu/rouge on the eval sets. Also run the reranker/longform prompts in dialog-robustness. If quality regression >1% on sacrebleu or visible hallucinations we block.

ryan.hansen: For batching configs, try both windowed batching (max_batch=64, window_ms=6) and continuous batching off. Also test kv-cache warmup pattern with 1-shot vs 0-shot.

maya.chen: HF repo: https://github.com/redwood/models/tree/main/tempest-lite (model card + eval-harness). Calibration corp: s3://redwood-eval/tempest/calib/512_samples.tar.gz.

maya.chen: Quick quant config snippet (post-training candidate):
```
q_config: per_channel
qkv_fuse: true
calibration_samples: 512
activation_clip: 4.0
```

arjun.patel: Got it. I'll use benchbot to schedule. benchbot, schedule fp16 baseline on a40-01, job tag tempest-lite-78923. command: `benchbot schedule --model tempest-lite-7b --precision fp16 --node a40-01 --tag tempest-lite-78923`

benchbot: Scheduled job 78923: fp16 baseline on a40-01. ETA ~12m. Will post logs to /artifacts/tempest-lite/78923/ and csv to /artifacts/tempest-lite/78923/summary.csv

benchbot: job 78923 finished. summary: p95=72ms, p50=28ms, avg_tok_s=150, mem_peak=10.2GB. Artifacts: https://redwood.storage/tempest-lite/78923.csv. Starting int8-ptq run (job 78924) next.

arjun.patel: FP16 looks healthy. Next runs queued. For int8-ptq I'll try two calibration sizes (512,2048) to see sensitivity.

samir.k: Reminder: capture output probs and token-level diffs for the prompt-suite. Use eval harness: `python evals/runner.py --model /artifacts/... --suite prod-smoke-v2 --out /artifacts/.../eval.json --metrics sacrebleu,logprob,fluency`

benchbot: job 78924 (int8-ptq, calib=512) finished. summary: p95=54ms, avg_tok_s=185, mem_peak=6.4GB. Qual quickcheck: sacrebleu delta -0.7% vs fp16. Artifacts: https://redwood.storage/tempest-lite/78924.csv

maya.chen: Good perf improvement. Caveat: quality delta is borderline. If int8-ptq quality drop >1% on full eval we don't promote. Samir, can you run the full regression tonight and paste a short summary?

samir.k: On it. I'll run full suites tonight and post a summary CSV. If we see any prompt categories with >1.0% degradation, I'll flag with examples.

arjun.patel: Uploading progressive results: https://redwood.storage/tempest-lite/bench/progress/78923-78924.zip. Also I'll post a small perf table once ctx sweep completes. ETA EOD.

maya.chen: Decision rule: if int8-ptq p95 <= fp16 p95*0.85 and sacrebleu drop <=1% then staging-ready. Otherwise we iterate on calibration or move to qat. :thumbsup:

ryan.hansen: Quick note for eng-runtime — if we get good numbers, we should test fallback policy mapping (int8->fp16) for tail latency spikes. cc @eng-runtime but will open a rollout ticket later.

benchbot: job 78930 (int8-qat) queued. Estimated runtime ~40m.

samir.k: Summary placeholder: will post final diff table (per-suite) and sample failures. If quality is within bounds we'll mark candidate build tag `tempest-lite-7b-q8-2026-03-20` as staging-ready and request canary window.

arjun.patel: final note — capturing trace logs for p95 spikes: `--trace tokenize,kv_cache,dispatch` turned on for the 8192 ctx runs so we can find any hotspots.

maya.chen: Thanks team. When results are in, please drop the CSV + one-line decision (promote/block) in this thread. We'll triage any regressions tomorrow morning.

benchbot: job 78930 (int8-qat) finished. quick metrics: p95=58ms, avg_tok_s=170, sacrebleu delta vs fp16 = -0.4%. Artifacts: https://redwood.storage/tempest-lite/78930.csv

samir.k: Full regressions done. Aggregate: sacrebleu -0.6%, rougeL -0.3%, low-severity hallucination cases: 4/1200 prompts (examples in artifacts). Conclusion: within thresholds. I vote promote to staging.

arjun.patel: I concur. I'll mark build `tempest-lite-7b-q8-2026-03-20` as staging-ready and open rollout ticket.

maya.chen: Promote to staging: approved. Thanks all. :tada:
